target.capability_owner: universal cognitive worker stale recovery allocator
target.mechanism: atomic per-opportunity active recovery lease arbitration

problem: Two recovery workers can concurrently observe no active recovery and append distinct recovery claims, creating overlapping writers on one opportunity.
acceptance: Concurrent recovery eligibility attempts for one opportunity and predecessor attempt produce exactly one active recovery lease winner.
Losers emit durable collision/boundary evidence and perform no target writes.
A recovery attempt that later becomes stale can itself be superseded only after threshold, with append-only predecessor lineage rather than overwriting the prior lease.
A repository-host create-if-absent race canary proves no overwrite under concurrent attempts.
No Current, Human Accepted, or Served authority promotion occurs.
title: Atomic Recovery Arbitration Lease V1
mission: Close the observed stale-recovery race by adding a deterministic, repository-host create-if-absent arbitration key for each opportunity + predecessor attempt. Exactly one worker may become the active recovery writer for that predecessor; racing workers must terminate without target writes. Preserve append-only recovery history and permit later recovery generations only by referencing the newly stale predecessor run.

incident_repair.reason: A live canary produced two append-only recovery claims seconds apart for the same stale kernel lineage, and a competing recovery run became active after the first claimant had already passed its preflight.

regression_prevention.reason: The current check-then-create recovery flow has a race window; without an atomic arbitration key, future high-parallelism waves can create overlapping writers despite each worker individually following the stale policy.

unblock_value.reason: Reliable stale recovery is a prerequisite for broad stress verification and for removing human scheduling/recovery from the critical path.

reuse_value.reason: The arbitration primitive applies to every retry-safe opportunity and can reuse create-if-absent semantics already proven by discovery fingerprint pins.

must_fail_if: two concurrent recovery attempts for the same opportunity + predecessor can both acquire active-writer authority
a collision loser performs any target write
arbitration overwrites or erases prior recovery evidence
a stale recovery cannot be superseded through a new predecessor lineage after the threshold
the lease grants Current, Human Accepted, Served, or global promotion authority
proof_required: repository-host create-if-absent race canary with at least two concurrent contenders and exactly one winner
loser boundary receipts showing zero target writes
stale-recovery-of-recovery fixture proving append-only next-generation lineage
